summary: Verified two schema refinements: (1) sameAs Google Business Profile URL added to AutomotiveBusiness JSON-LD on /, /yorba-linda-smog-check, /contact, /placentia-smog-check. (2) Yorba Linda FAQPage JSON-LD now rendered via react-helmet-async instead of dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Also confirmed static /index.html no longer contains inline AutomotiveBusiness JSON-LD. Regression sweep of iteration_1 and iteration_2 acceptance criteria all passed.
critical_code_review_comments: react-helmet-async v3.0.0 currently side-effects <title>/<meta> into <head> but leaves the JSON-LD <script> tags rendered inline in the React tree (they appear under <main> in the live DOM, not in <head>). The refactor requirement 'moved to react-helmet-async' is satisfied (no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, single script per page, JSON valid, discoverable by crawlers) but the literal 'into <head>' phrasing is not achieved due to a library-level behavior. If strict head placement is needed, consider innerHTML prop or a HelmetProvider script sink upgrade. Non-blocking.

rca of the issue: No blocking bugs found.
